title: What's new in v2.9.0
summary: Health checks you write yourself: a command run on any UniFi device, a condition on what it returns, and an alert or an action on the device when it fails.

steps.title: Health Checks
steps.listLabel: Watch anything on a device, and act on it when it fails
steps.body:
Open a device on the **Devices** card and add a command to run on it over SSH, what counts as a problem, and what to do about it: alert, restart a service, kill a process, or reboot.

The **UniFi Network JVM GC Thrash** template catches a Cloud Gateway's Network application stalled in garbage collection and restarts it.

Each check gets its own chart on **Device Stats**.

steps.title: Active Alerts
steps.listLabel: Handle your most urgent alerts from the Dashboard
steps.body: The **Active Alerts** card shows your three most severe unresolved alerts. **Acknowledge** or **Resolve** them in place, or open **View All** for the rest.
